tagline: A global leader in life sciences, diagnostics and applied markets
hero_kpi_rationale: This segment is Agilent's primary growth driver, contributing 11% growth in 2025, driven by the BIOVECTRA acquisition and demand for molecular and clinical solutions, making it the central strategic lever.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company in a year from sales of products and services.
kpis.description: Total revenue increased by 7% in 2025 to $6.948 billion, following a 5% decline in 2024. Growth was driven across all segments and regions, with a positive contribution from the BIOVECTRA acquisition.
kpis.signal: Strong 7% growth in 2025 following a 5% decline in 2024.

kpis.name: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from instruments, reagents and services for biomedical research and diagnostics.
kpis.description: This segment, newly formed in November 2024, combines diagnostics, genomics and liquid chromatography. It posted 11% growth in 2025, driven by demand for clinical and molecular solutions.
kpis.signal: High-growth segment (+11%), amplified by the BIOVECTRA acquisition contributing approximately 5 percentage points of growth.

kpis.name: Agilent CrossLab Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from laboratory consumables, services, software and automation.
kpis.description: The CrossLab segment, which includes services, consumables and software, grew 6% in 2025, after +3% in 2024, reflecting stable demand for maintenance and automation solutions.
kpis.signal: Steady growth in services and consumables, attractive recurring revenue model.

kpis.name: Applied Markets Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from instruments used in substance analysis across industry and research.
kpis.description: This segment, impacted in 2024 by reduced customer capex spending, rebounded slightly in 2025 with +1%, despite an unfavorable currency impact.
kpis.signal: Modest recovery following a 7% decline in 2024.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all expenses, taxes and charges.
kpis.description: Net income reached $1.303 billion in 2025, up from $1.289 billion in 2024, supported by tax benefits.
kpis.signal: Slight increase driven by tax benefits in 2025.

kpis.name: Cash Balance
kpis.explanation: Available liquidity to fund operations or investments.
kpis.description: Cash balance reached $1.789 billion in October 2025, compared to $1.329 billion a year earlier, strengthening capacity for investments or share buybacks.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in cash balance, supporting financial flexibility.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last five reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $4.472 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2017).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $1.479 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.51 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.282 billion in the latest year.

kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years using yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.

risks.title: Tariff pressures and trade policies
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the MDA section with strong language on uncertainty and increasing cost impact starting in the second half of 2025. The text indicates that pressures are fluid and require active mitigation strategies. The geopolitical category is highly weighted in the current context.

risks.title: Dependence on pharmaceutical markets
risks.score_rationale: The 2024 decline was explicitly attributed to pressures on pharmaceutical customers' capital spending. Although 2025 shows recovery, the risk is recurring and affects multiple segments. Central to earnings analysis.
